name: directives/theme-fn-opacity
description: `theme('colors.x.500 / 50%')` applies an alpha to the resolved color value, producing `rgb(R G B / 50%)`. Mirrors upstream's `withAlphaValue`.
inputCss: .a { color: theme('colors.red.500 / 50%'); } .b { color: theme('colors.blue.500 / 0.5'); } .c { background: theme('colors.green.500 / 25%'); }
